title: Bastion Reprieve
description: More piglins, less brutes. A compromise between 1.16.1 and modern Minecraft.
body:
Ever since Brutes were added in 1.16.2, they've taken up slots in Bastions, reducing how many tradable piglins there are.

This datapack compromises by spawning a few more piglins and culling 25% of all brutes to be closer to 1.16.1. This datapack is also useful if you simply want bastions to be easier without completely getting rid of brutes.

You can also use [Pity Edition](https://modrinth.com/project/bastion-reprieve-pe) if you want an experience closer to the modern game. Fewer bonus piglins will spawn and every 4th brute is spared instead of removed.
